thread:
Taylor (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we published two handbook updates this morning: PTO carryover rules clarified and parental leave wording standardized. Managers need to acknowledge the changes by EOD Fri 2026-04-02. Also rolling out a short mandatory compliance micro-course (Policy Essentials, ~25m).
Priya (HR Manager): Link to the tracker + ack column: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFghijkl/ - please fill in your name + date. I added a comments column for exceptions. @managers :wave:
Jonas (Legal): Confirmed the parental leave wording is cleared for US/EU variants. Flagging one sentence for UK contractors — Priya, I left a note in the sheet.
Amy (People Ops): I'll run a pulse export of outstanding acks on Monday. If you want a CSV for your org, DM me and I'll generate it.
Marcus (Hiring): For hiring teams — include "policy ack complete" as a gating task in the offer checklist. If a new manager starts, they get an onboarding flow that includes the micro-course.
Taylor (People Ops): Quick how-to for managers: 1) open the tracker, 2) set "Acked" = Yes + date, 3) if you need an exception, add a comment and tag @Priya. If you haven't finished the module, status should be "In progress".
Priya (HR Manager): Course link: https://learn.redwood/courses/policy-essentials — use SSO. It auto-logs completion and updates the tracker via our connector. If it doesn't, screenshot the completion and upload to the sheet.
Marcus (Hiring): Do we want to auto-remind hiring managers if they haven't acked within 7 days of offer? Could be helpful.
Taylor (People Ops): Good idea. Amy can enable a scheduled reminder. Amy? :slightly_smiling_face:
Amy (People Ops): Yep — enabling weekly reminders for outstanding manager acks starting next Monday. Also exporting a per-team CSV for GMs.
Jonas (Legal): Small note: the change is not retroactive to leaves already approved. Added a line to the handbook section to make that explicit.
Taylor (People Ops): If your team needs a short readout for a manager meeting, I can prep a 2-slide summary.
Priya (HR Manager): One ask from Compliance: please complete the course by the deadline — we need 100% manager coverage for audit.
People Bot: Reminder scheduled: Managers with outstanding acks will receive an automated DM Tue 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC.
Marcus (Hiring): For part-time managers — do they follow the same ack cadence?
Taylor (People Ops): Yes, same cadence. If someone truly cannot complete due to role constraints, tag @Priya and we'll handle case-by-case.
Priya (HR Manager): I'll run a final compliance report on Mon 2026-04-05 and loop in Legal + People Ops.
Amy (People Ops): To help managers, here's a quick export command for the tracker (admins only):
```
# admin export: list managers who haven't acked
curl -s "https://people-tools/api/export?sheet=policy-acks" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PEOPLE_TOKEN" | jq '.rows[] | select(.acked==false) | .email'
```
Taylor (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Ping me if the sheet link breaks or you need the slide deck. :thumbsup:
Priya (HR Manager): Adding final note — managers who miss the deadline will get a follow-up from their People Partner. Please treat this as high priority.
Amy (People Ops): Closing loop: I'll post a summary thread with compliance numbers after the final report.
Taylor (People Ops): End of thread — will post updates as we get them.
